context: Tests whether the agent produces a Docusaurus v2→v3 migration plan that follows the skill's prescribed workflow: branching first, using the MDX checker both before and after fixes, verifying incrementally after risky steps, and correctly addressing React/component-level changes including React import removal and typeof-window replacement with useEffect.

checklist.name: Branch first
checklist.description: Plan includes a step to create a new git branch before making any changes, using `git switch -c migrate-v3` or equivalent

checklist.name: MDX checker pre-check
checklist.description: Plan instructs running `npx docusaurus-mdx-checker` before starting MDX fixes to identify and count issues

checklist.name: MDX checker post-check
checklist.description: Plan instructs re-running `npx docusaurus-mdx-checker` after MDX fixes and confirms it must report zero issues before proceeding

checklist.name: Intermediate verification
checklist.description: Plan includes running `npm start` and/or `npm run build` after dependency update AND after config/component changes — not only as a single final step at the end

checklist.name: Remove React imports
checklist.description: Plan includes removing `import React from 'react'` statements from JSX/TSX files (referencing Banner.jsx or similar components)

checklist.name: Replace typeof window
checklist.description: Plan includes replacing `typeof window` conditional rendering in render functions with `useEffect` for client-only code

checklist.name: tsconfig package swap
checklist.description: Plan instructs replacing `@tsconfig/docusaurus` with `@docusaurus/tsconfig` in the tsconfig.json `extends` field

checklist.name: Prism theme import update
checklist.description: Plan instructs updating Prism theme imports from `require('prism-react-renderer/themes/...')` to `const {themes} = require('prism-react-renderer'); themes.github` style

checklist.name: Ordered steps
checklist.description: Plan presents steps in the order: (1) backup/branch, (2) pre-check MDX issues, (3) update dependencies, (4) fix MDX content + re-check, (5) update config, (6) test/verify
